Where a file passes _classify but `not (wt / rel).is_file()`: call succ = moved_to(rel, tid, repo_root=repo_root, worktree=wt). If succ is already in measured or moved, or _classify(succ) is not None, `continue`. Otherwise set source, rel = rel, succ and moved[rel] = source.
